summary_md: **そう@『n8nの教科書』マイナビ出版 10/22発売 ([@so_ainsight](https://x.com/so_ainsight/status/2116466469949325403))** lists ten fast-rising AI repos of the week: Cloudflare's multi-phase **security-audit-skill**, the Orca multi-agent workspace, Impeccable design vocabulary, Graphify knowledge graphs, HeyGen's HyperFrames HTML-to-video, TradingAgents, freellmapi, claude-seo, OpenCode and Postiz ([cloudflare/security-audit-skill](https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill), [heygen-com/hyperframes](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes)); a follow-up links his longer write-up.
